answer_1.quote: Machine Translation (MT), the automated process of converting text from one language to another
answer_1.outputs: Amharic to English and English to Amharic translations

answer_2.quote: For the automatic evaluation, we employed four metrics: BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy), METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), ChrF++, and TER (Translation Edit Rate) automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, volunteers were recruited as annotators, and they provided informed consent, ensuring transparency and adherence to ethical standards.
answer_4.guideline: This survey aims to identify common errors in the current multilingual machine translation models on Amharic--English translation. ... Your task is to identify error types and their severity from the translation.
